findings.title: Unrequested company name + tagline header
findings.detail: Spec Goal/Implementation step 1 call for only the "Tentang Kami" heading, the about paragraphs, the team list and the Beranda link; PRD §Halaman Tentang Kami is likewise limited to "Profil singkat (dua–tiga paragraf statis), daftar tim..., dan tautan kembali ke Beranda." The overline rendering companyProfile.name and the companyProfile.tagline line (lines 34-40) are copy neither the unit spec nor the PRD section requested for this page.

findings.title: Decorative briefcase icon per team member
findings.detail: Not requested by spec step 1 ("the team as a semantic list of name + role"); aria-hidden and not an img so it does not trip D-002, but it is unrequested decoration.

findings.title: Decorative arrow-left icon on Beranda button
findings.detail: startIcon glyph is UI decoration not called for by Implementation step 1.

findings.title: The "no photos or avatars" test cannot detect an avatar
findings.detail: querySelector('img') and queryAllByRole('img') only find image elements; an MUI Avatar with initials renders a div and one with no content an aria-hidden svg, so both still pass. The sibling HomeView uses CustomAvatar (HomeView/index.tsx:75). Fix: also assert container.querySelector('.MuiAvatar-root') is null, inside the team list items too.

findings.title: a data-testid added only for the test
findings.detail: Only data-testid in src/; paragraphs already sit in a labelled section "Profil perusahaan" (line 43). Drop it and query within the region.

findings.title: hand-built width wrapper instead of MUI Container
findings.detail: Lines 31-32 build main/div with max-is-[1100px]; the sibling uses Container maxWidth lg (HomeView/index.tsx:39-40), so widths/padding differ (1100 vs 1200px).

findings.title: The metadata test only re-checks a hard-coded value
findings.detail: expect(metadata.title).toBe('Tentang Kami') compares literals and couples the view test to the route file.

findings.title: Overline brand label fails 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG AA)
findings.detail: color='primary.main' resolves to #7367F0 (src/configs/primaryColorConfig.ts:13) on page background #F8F7FA/#FFFFFF (src/@core/theme/colorSchemes.ts:86-87); contrast about 4.2-4.3:1, below the design slice's 4.5:1 rule for normal text (12px overline is not large text). Fix: a theme colour meeting AA (text.primary/text.secondary or a darker primary shade).

findings.title: Team-member name skips heading levels (h2 -> h6)
findings.detail: Typography variant h6 with no component override renders <h6> under the <h2> "Tim Kami" (line 54). Fix: component='p' or 'h3'.

findings.title: Arbitrary max-width value instead of a layout token
findings.detail: max-is-[1100px] instead of Container maxWidth lg used elsewhere.

findings.title: The D-002 test catches photos but not avatars
findings.detail: Only img elements and role=img are checked; an MUI Avatar/CustomAvatar with initials renders div.MuiAvatar-root (sibling HomeView/index.tsx:75 uses it), so an avatar in the team rows would still pass. Fix: assert container.querySelector('.MuiAvatar-root') is null and that each list item holds exactly name + role.

findings.title: 'use client' on a view with no state, hooks or handlers
findings.detail: Could be a server component; matches the HomeView precedent, optional.

findings.title: The view test imports the app route module to test metadata
findings.detail: Lines 63-67 only check the literal metadata.title and tie the view test to the app/ route.

findings.title: New data-testid selector idiom not used anywhere else in repo
findings.detail: data-testid='about-paragraph' exists only to count paragraphs; sibling tests use semantic role queries.

findings.title: Alias inconsistent with same-directory sibling
findings.detail: HomeView/index.tsx:29 imports @configs/companyProfile; AboutView uses @/configs/companyProfile (both resolve).

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips levels (h2 -> h6)
findings.detail: h1 (line 34) -> h2 "Tim Kami" (line 50) -> h6 team-member names (line 66); HomeView nests h1 -> h2 -> h3. Fix: variant='h6' component='h3' or drop the heading role.

findings.title: Hard-coded pixel max-width instead of theme/Container token
findings.detail: max-is-[1100px] one-off value; HomeView uses Container maxWidth='lg'.

findings.title: Floor met, ceiling absent vs the sibling pattern
findings.detail: Plain cards with no accent, iconography, depth or motion compared with HomeView's tinted hero, avatars and hover motion (lines 39-73).

findings.title: role="listitem" not set explicitly on team li items
findings.detail: list-style none can strip item roles in Safari/VoiceOver; container has role=list only.

findings.title: "Profil perusahaan" section has no visible heading
findings.detail: Only an aria-label, while the team section has a visible h2.
